laws.rule: National Botanical Garden, Mont Fleuri: SPGA requires paid entry for non-citizens. On-site payment is by card, not cash. Its general visitor page gives 16:30 as last entry and a 17:00 closing time, while the Garden page gives 16:30 closing; confirm the finishing time with SPGA and do not plan entry after 16:30. Contact SPGA before arranging a private function or use of facilities.
